subject.title: fix(exec-approvals): handle same-process sync/async lock contention

question: May synchronous exec authorization ever read the pre-update policy while a same-process async policy mutation owns the shared lock?
rationale: The proposed availability fix changes the freshness boundary protecting revocations and restrictive policy updates, so the permanent coordination design needs approval from the owner of the recently merged serialization work.

options.title: Preserve strict serialization
options.body: Keep synchronous authorization blocked or fail closed during mutations and remove the self-contention at the owning call path without exposing stale policy.

options.title: Permit stale reads explicitly
options.body: Accept lockless reads during same-process writes as a documented security tradeoff and add proof defining which policy transitions may be observed stale.

recommendation.title: Preserve strict serialization
recommendation.body: Keep synchronous authorization blocked or fail closed during mutations and remove the self-contention at the owning call path without exposing stale policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged exec-approval concurrency work defines the serialization and revocation-freshness contract affected by this PR.
